findings.problem: The final transport argument introduces an equality alias and two intermediate quasi-isomorphism instances, repeatedly spelling out the mapped morphism. The same mathematical steps can be expressed directly as successive goal reductions.
findings.proposed_change:
Keep lines 19–25, remove the now-unused Φ abbreviation on line 18, and replace lines 26–34 with:

findings.benefit: The proof visibly follows the same three ideas—forget scalars, precompose with the comparison isomorphism, and use naturality—without bookkeeping hypotheses or repeated long expressions. It preserves all assumptions and covers zero complexes and trivial algebras without additional cases.

lemma quasiIso_map_iff_of_preservesHomology [F.ReflectsIsomorphisms] :
    QuasiIso ((F.mapHomologicalComplex c).map φ) ↔ QuasiIso φ := by
  simp only [quasiIso_iff, quasiIsoAt_map_iff_of_preservesHomology φ F]

lemma quasiIso_iff_comp_left (φ : K ⟶ L) (φ' : L ⟶ M) [∀ i, K.HasHomology i]
    [∀ i, L.HasHomology i] [∀ i, M.HasHomology i]
    [hφ : QuasiIso φ] :
    QuasiIso (φ ≫ φ') ↔ QuasiIso φ' := by

theorem scalarForgetTotalIso_naturality (f : P ⟶ P') (g : Q ⟶ Q') :
    mapBifunctorMap (((forgetField k A).mapHomologicalComplex _).map f)
      (((forgetField k B).mapHomologicalComplex _).map g)
      (MonoidalCategory.curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} k)) (ComplexShape.down ℕ) ≫
        (scalarForgetTotalIso k A B P' Q').hom =
      (scalarForgetTotalIso k A B P Q).hom ≫
        (((forgetField k (A ⊗[k] B)).mapHomologicalComplex _).map
          (mapBifunctorMap f g (bifunctor k A B) (ComplexShape.down ℕ))) := by
